_note: The Title Case and quoting rules come from the es team's own stated conventions (see es_ES.md). The rest is standard Spanish orthography. Rules marked not-researched need the es guide read before enabling.

6e_apostrophe_accent._why: not-applicable: this is Italian orthography (e' for e-grave).

6f_title_case._why: es team rule: 'No se admiten capitalizaciones dentro de las frases salvo nombres propios y excepciones aceptadas por la RAE.'

6g_space_before_punctuation._why: Spanish attaches punctuation to the preceding word. Note the opening marks in a pair are attached to the FOLLOWING word.

6g_oxford_comma._why: Spanish does not use a serial comma before the final conjunction.

6i_loanword_plural._why: not-researched: Spanish commonly pluralises borrowed nouns (plugins, widgets). Confirm against the es glossary before enabling.

6j_please._why: not-researched: Spanish convention for 'Por favor' in device messages is not documented here.

6k_gerund._why: not-researched: no documented Spanish equivalent of Italian's 'in corso'.

6l_clock_24h._why: Spain uses the 24-hour clock in written/UI contexts.
